background: Nykredit is Denmark's largest mortgage lender, a mutual-owned group that funds Danish residential and commercial mortgages through covered bonds under the Danish balance-principle system, with a commercial and retail bank alongside.
synthesis: Rated AA- on average across all three, the weakest at A+, one on a positive outlook and two stable, after a two-notch upgrade by one of the three on 12 May 2026. Liquidity is very strong, with LCR of 501% and NSFR of 143% in the top quarter of EU and Nordic banks, NSFR up 10 points since 30 Jun 2025, and CET1 of 17.0% is above the peer median. Leverage of 4.5% is in the bottom quarter, which is the weak spot and typical of a covered-bond mortgage lender. There has been no rating action in the last 90 days.
